messages:
From: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@acmecorp.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: overnight P1 response coverage for launch next week

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you're well — Acme's product launch has been moved up and we're going live next Friday night (UTC). We expect an elevated P1 volume between 02:00–06:00 UTC for three nights during the launch window.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide temporary on-call coverage (or approved delegation) for those overnight hours? We need a named Redwood contact who can act as first responder.
- If full P1 SLA (15-minute response) can't be guaranteed overnight, will Redwood accept a temporary, documented exception to 30 minutes for those nights? We need this in writing for our launch runbook and to satisfy our internal stakeholders.

Attached is our launch schedule and traffic forecast. Also cc'ing our ops alias (ops@acmecorp.com).

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we need the statement for our runbook by EOD today.

Thanks,
Lisa Turner
Head of Platform Ops, AcmeCorp
Attachments: acmecorp-launch-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@acmecorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00

Hi Lisa — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the accelerated timeline. Short answer: we can support a temporary operational change, but we need to lock down the delegation details and the scope.

Proposed approach (high level):
1) Delegation window: three nights, 02:00–06:00 UTC (as you specified).
2) Temporary SLA adjustment: P1 response target 30 minutes for those specific nights only; P2 remains unchanged. This is an exception, not a permanent SLO change.
3) Named Redwood contacts: 
   - Primary responder: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) — will act as on-call first responder during the window.
   - Backup: Evelyn Hart (evelyn_hart@redwood.com).
4) Escalation path: Customer -> Ben (first) -> Evelyn (backup) -> Redwood Platform Lead (if unresolved within 90 minutes). We'll include pager numbers in the signed runbook.
5) Shadowing/overlap: We recommend a 30-minute overlap between Acme ops and Redwood responder at the start of each window for knowledge handoff.

Next steps I need from you today:
- Signoff on the temporary P1 response target (15 -> 30 minutes) for the three nights.
- A completed delegation matrix (I attached a template) with Acme primary contact and any legal/ procurement contact for the DocuSign.

Attachments: redwood-delegation-matrix.xlsx (template)
Doc links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1234 (runbook ticket)

If you confirm, we'll get this into a short addendum and share a DocuSign link for signature before EOD.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Lisa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal alignment, Redwood agrees to the temporary coverage plan for the Acme launch. Agreed items below (for your runbook):

1) Coverage window and dates: Nightly 02:00–06:00 UTC on 2026-08-21, 2026-08-22, and 2026-08-23.
2) P1 response target: 30 minutes (temporary exception for the three nights only). P1 triage within 15 minutes where possible; targeted SLA is 30 minutes and will be used in post-launch reporting.
3) Named responders: Ben Carter (primary) — ben_carter@redwood.com; Evelyn Hart (backup) — evelyn_hart@redwood.com.
4) Escalation ladder: Acme ops -> Ben -> Evelyn -> Redwood Platform Lead (escalate if unresolved after 90 minutes).
5) Handoff: 30-minute overlap at start of each window for knowledge transfer.
6) Telemetry hook: please provide a PagerDuty webhook or dedicated Slack channel.
7) DocuSign: I have created a short addendum and sent a DocuSign link to your procurement contact. Please return the signed addendum before midnight PT on 2026-08-20 so we can finalize schedules.

Attachments: acmecorp-sla-uptime-req.pdf (copy for your runbook)
Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1234 (tracking ticket), https://drive.google.com/file/d/abc123/view (delegation matrix template)

If the signoff is received, Ben will be added to Acme's on-call calendar and we'll schedule the 30-minute pre-launch handoff call for the first night.

Looking forward to a smooth launch — reach out if anything changes.
